name: zammad
label: Zammad
description: Open-source helpdesk: find the tickets assigned to the agent, read them, reply internally or to the customer, set state, assign, escalate. Work by polling or webhook.

versions.notes: A reply whose body is HTML is sent as text/html instead of showing its tags; reply takes an optional content_type.

An agent finds its own work now: list_tickets (the tickets assigned to an owner, new/open), search_tickets (full text), assign (take or hand over), and a heartbeat pre-check behind nur-wenn: zammad:assigned, zammad:unassigned or zammad:owner:<login>. The webhook stays optional.
Was compiled into Covey up to 0.5.0. Same actions; COVEY_ZAMMAD_REPLY_TYPE is now the reply_type parameter, and the group allowlist belongs in the Zammad trigger.
